UI_MinidoracatQuest_ShowDock_tooltip: The Quests & Achievements button on the family toolbar. When hidden, the hotkey (Key Bindings > [MinidoracatQuest]) still opens the window.
UI_MinidoracatQuest_ShowBroadcast_toolti: Notices when another player unlocks a high achievement tier.
UI_MinidoracatQuest_ShowHud_tooltip: Top left: the progress of the quests and achievements you marked with "Track" on a card. Drag it to move it; drag its right edge to limit its width.
UI_MinidoracatQuest_ShowHeadTitles_toolt: The title each player wears, one line above the name. Hidden when the server hides names. Turning it off also saves this computer the drawing.
UI_MinidoracatQuest_ShowChatTitles_toolt: The author's title after the name in chat lines.
